concerns.text: FR-007 requires the neural‑teacher baseline to be trained on the *original Causal Forcing++ dataset*, yet the plan substitutes the same synthetic physics dataset because the original dataset is unavailable. This creates a mismatch: the physics‑teacher model and the neural‑teacher baseline are trained on different data distributions, but US‑03 and SC‑004 assume a paired t‑test on *the same test sequences*. Comparing models trained on non‑identical training data violates the independence of the validation target from the predictor and renders the statistical significance claim invalid.
